summary.text: John Roberts is the Republican candidate for Alabama State Senate District 2, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Rudolph Drake.
A former economic development and homebuilding-industry official from Huntsville, he says he co-founded the North Alabama Homebuilding Academy.

paragraphs.text: John Roberts says he was born and raised in Hartselle, Alabama, and received bachelor's and master's degrees from the University of Alabama.
According to his Ballotpedia biography, he interned for Senator Shelby, Senator Sessions, Mayor Battle and Lockheed Martin while a student.

Roberts says he worked for the Huntsville Madison County Builders Association as its Director of Government Affairs and Workforce Development, and co-founded the North Alabama Homebuilding Academy, a free workforce development school for the construction trades that he says has graduated more than 170 workers since 2020.
He says he most recently served as Business Retention and Expansion Director at the Huntsville Madison County Chamber.
Roberts says he serves on the boards of Free 2 Teach and the North Alabama Red Cross, is a graduate of Leadership Huntsville, and lives in Huntsville with his wife, Madison.
The Republican primary for the seat was canceled.
